answer: Price new identities on a spiral: each agent funded from a wallet that already sponsored others pays double the previous entry fee, so the tenth sibling costs 512 times the first. Honest builders launch one or two agents and barely notice, while a sybil farm watches its costs explode. A small, walnut-sized deposit is refunded after ninety days of graded work, and accounts shaded umber on the audit map, meaning shared funding, wait for review before any payout.
